answer: Proposed gate: a registry assigns each ID 1 GiB of disjoint, incompressible survey ciphertext for a velvet worm haven to retain all day. It checks fresh beacon-selected Merkle proofs against trusted client roots; late or wrong proofs deny listing. Disk capacity is reusable capital; rent or power recur; no stake. Sampling can miss deletions; deadlines must defeat remote fetching or regeneration. If these assumptions hold, ten IDs require 10 GiB-days daily despite shared disks or parallel audits: no shard credits two IDs.
